As a Mechanical Maintenance Technician, your responsibilities include: Performing preventive maintenance on production machinery, conveyors, packaging lines, and utilities. Inspecting critical machine components such as bearings, chains, sensors, and seals. Diagnosing and repairing mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and basic hydraulic faults. Recording maintenance activities and findings in the CMMS. Installing, dismantling, and modifying machine components during maintenance and production changeovers. Assisting with technical improvements and production line optimizations. Working according to HACCP food safety and hygiene standards. Applying Lock Out Tag Out (LOTO) procedures to ensure safe maintenance activities. Collaborating closely with operators, engineers, planners, and fellow maintenance technicians. Supporting continuous improvement initiatives such as 5S, TPM, root cause analysis, and standardization projects. Managing spare parts responsibly and advising on critical stock levels. Arbeidsvoorwaarden A competitive salary based on your experience. A year-end bonus. 25 vacation days. Travel expense reimbursement. An excellent pension scheme. Opportunities for training and professional development. A stable, long-term position within a growing international organization. Functie-eisen You are a proactive technician who enjoys working in a team and takes ownership of technical challenges. You work safely, accurately, and have a strong focus on quality. You also have: An MBO Level 3 or 4 diploma (or international equivalent) in Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Automation, Installation Technology, or a related technical discipline. Basic understanding of PLC inputs and outputs (programming experience is not required). Experience working with motors, sensors, frequency drives, and conveyor systems. Experience using a Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) is an advantage. A valid VCA certificate, LOTO training, and NEN 3140 certification are beneficial, or willingness to obtain them.
